headline: Bank of Japan Assets Fall 10.1% YoY to ¥625 Trillion
summary: Total Bank of Japan assets contracted 10.1% year-over-year to ¥624.98 trillion. Holdings of Japanese government securities stood at approximately ¥502.1 trillion to ¥504.00 trillion depending on the accounting methodology.
why: The Bank of Japan's balance sheet adjustments reflect its normalization path away from massive quantitative easing, which impacts Japanese bond yields and global capital flows.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: A shrinking central bank balance sheet aligns with policy normalization but depends on pace of rate adjustments.
